description: Call after registering an exploration's directions. Refreshes and returns the path of its comparison page (compare.html: every direction side by side, opens in any browser from the file system), lists registered and missing directions, and with contactSheet: true renders a PNG of the comparison with the installed browser. If you can view images, check the contact sheet that the directions really differ before showing the user.

contactSheet.description: Also render the comparison page to exports/contact-sheet.png. Default false.

name: compare_open_design_exploration
